test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Out of the four words listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
Here, Fish, Bear and Pig are the names of the animals.

So, all the given words are names of animals except the word **'Hibiscus' **as it is the name of a flower.

Hence, the odd one is '__**Hibiscus**__'.
